Name: Camboy Sebastian Dialogue Mod
Author: Udunie
Description:
Heyo!

This is my first mod, inspired by the various 'lewd dialogue' mods that a lot of the Stardew Valley ladies already have, and it features camboy!Sebastian!
It's not a complete overwrite of his dialogue, just adds a little spice to him without being too much (at least I hope)...

The mod includes the following changes:
- slightly rewrites Sebastian's two heart event
- rewrites/adds new dialogue to Sebastian (mostly from 4 hearts and up)

The mod is for 1.6  and up and should work with any portrait mods, and probably with dialogue mods too, but it hasn't been tested with other stuff... I think it can work with any farmer gender, but would work best with male or gnc farmer.

Anyway, I hope you guys will enjoy it, and let me know if there are any problems/errors and I will try to work it out.

I'm not promising anything, but if you have any requests regarding lewd dialogue mods for any of the bachelors, let me know!

Manifest.Description: Adds dialogue about Sebastian working as a camboy
